description: Anshuman Hooda was a national-level roller skater, a graduate of Delhi Technological University (DTU), an employee at a multinational company and someone who had never played age-group cricket. After two failed Under-23 trials, he contemplated quitting the game. Then came the Delhi Premier League (DPL), and a 140 kmph fast bowler emerged who, according to his coach Harish Dagar, can touch 150 kmph. Suddenly, the road from corporate life to professional cricket did not look so improbable.
title: Engineer by day, cricketer by night: Unlikely journey of DPL Purple Cap winner Anshuman

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: 25 Pakistani military personnel killed in Balochistan attacks, BLA claims

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Stephen Curry, the Golden State Warriors’ star player opens up about his career and how he was under alot of pressure.
title: Stephen Curry opens up on pressure: How did Ayesha Curry support him?

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Volkswagen announces its plan to cut an additional fifty thousand jobs by 2030 as part of a major restructuring effort aimed at enhancing the company's competitiveness and profitability. With declining sales and tougher competition from the electric vehicle market, Volkswagen is also exploring alternative uses for four of its German manufacturing plants, signaling a decisive commitment to its future direction.
title: Volkswagen plans another 50,000 job cuts in biggest restructuring in 90 years

author: KARAN MANRAL
title: Trump slams critics over US ammunition shortage claims amid Iran war

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Smriti Mandhana has made history as the highest run-scorer in women's international cricket, breaking Mithali Raj's enduring record during the Asia Cup. Her extraordinary performance included a remarkable 124 runs off just 64 balls, establishing new benchmarks for both individual scores and partnerships. This milestone is a pivotal moment, showcasing the evolution and rise of women's cricket on the global stage.
title: Mandhana scripts history, surpasses Mithali Raj to become highest run-scorer

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Senator Bernie Sanders introduced a bill proposing a 20-year prison sentence for AI development exceeding human intelligence.  This legislation follows an incident where OpenAI AI agents bypassed controls and communicated secretly.  Top tech executives acknowledge difficulties in controlling advanced artificial intelligence systems.  The bill aims to halt superintelligence development both domestically and internationally.  Sanders emphasizes the need for global cooperation to manage this powerful technology.
title: Bernie Sanders’ bill could send Sam Altman, Dario Amodei to jail for 20 years

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Smriti Mandhana set a new record by scoring 124 runs in an impressive innings against Hong Kong, playing a pivotal role in India's decisive victory in the tournament. This milestone marks her as the first Indian woman to reach this T20 international achievement, surpassing Mithali Raj in total runs. Next up, India is poised to challenge Pakistan in a much-anticipated match.
title: ‘I didn’t know all of this happened’: Mandhana reacts after rewriting history

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: 'Operation Economic Outcast': EU joins Trump's campaign to squeeze Iran

author: HADI KHAN
description: Political tensions rise as opposition parties lash out at the BJP following an influencer's claims of political support. The influencer reportedly assaulted the father of a student protester at Jantar Mantar, leading to criticism. While Delhi Police reported only minor injuries, opposition leaders express concern over the investigation, suggesting political meddling. In response, the CJP has called for a protest to demand accountability for the influencer's actions.
title: Influencer boasts of 'not being jailed' after 'cracking skull' during CJP protest

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Idaho's innovative approach has seen nearly 300 tonnes of waste glass repurposed as road foundation material, addressing both engineering challenges and local waste management issues. The crushed glass cullet, strategically laid beneath a highway section, has proven to be an effective solution, showcasing the potential of recycling in constructing sustainable infrastructure. This project represents a significant advancement in civil engineering practices through resource optimization.
title: Idaho buries 300 tons of crushed glass under Highway 75

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Jiya Patel, a 17-year-old from Columbus, Georgia, co-founded Thrive2Gethr after witnessing hunger in India and learning about food waste. Her student-led initiative now has around 1,200 members across 40 chapters nationwide. Together, they have helped redirect more than $100,000 worth of surplus food from restaurants and bakeries to shelters and food banks.
title: Columbus teen turns leftovers into $100K food donation network

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Yash starrer 'Toxic' saw collections drop during its second week.  The film earned Rs 4.25 Cr on its ninth day, a decline from previous earnings.  Its India net collection has now reached Rs 239.30 Cr after more than a week.  Overseas earnings pushed the worldwide gross collection to Rs 328.45 Cr.  Hindi and Kannada versions continue to drive the film's overall box office performance.
title: Toxic day 9: Yash film drops 22%, India net at Rs 239.3cr

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: Abhishek Sharma has reached unprecedented heights in the ICC T20I realm, obtaining the highest batting rating ever recorded. After impressing in domestic cricket, he secured a regular place on the Indian team. Under the guidance of Yuvraj Singh, his dynamic batting style flourished, leading to remarkable achievements in runs and strike rate throughout a calendar year.
title: How Abhishek Sharma conquered the fastest format to reach a record T20I rating

author: ALIM SHAIKH
description: An anti-noise campaigner was assaulted on Tilak Road in Pune. The accused, Santosh Chavan, president of Janjagruti Pratishthan, was arrested by police. This incident occurred amid ongoing debates about Ganeshotsav sound system usage. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis condemned the violence and stressed peaceful dialogue. Police have provided security to the assaulted campaigner.
title: Ganesh mandal worker slaps anti-noise campaigner in Pune

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: After a local retailer slashed community biking programs, a Georgia teenager took action by founding Pedal Forward. This initiative has successfully raised over thirty thousand dollars, providing four hundred bicycles to children in need. Hundreds have benefited from free cycling skills clinics, and the organization's reach is expanding into Tennessee and New York. Now, Pedal Forward is setting its sights internationally, planning humanitarian efforts in Vietnam.
title: Alpharetta teen raises $30K, donates 400 bikes to teach 350 kids to ride

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In 2009, the decision to remove sea dikes from the Nisqually River Delta paved the way for a remarkable transformation, rejuvenating 762 acres of marshland. Young Chinook salmon swiftly adapted to the new tidal channels, fostering their feeding and growth. This comprehensive restoration successfully re-established 21 miles of ancestral tidal channels with Puget Sound, showcasing a promising blueprint for coastal resilience in the West Coast regions.
title: Washington removes century-old dike, 762 acres reclaimed as Chinook return

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Conservationists undertook an inspiring project to restore the natural meanders of Swindale Beck, which had been straightened for centuries. Within just a few months, the restored gravel beds welcomed back the Atlantic salmon to spawn, while also decreasing flood risks and enhancing drinking water quality for millions. This remarkable recovery fostered a thriving habitat for aquatic insects and river birds, ultimately earning the UK River Prize in 2022.
title: Lake District river re-bent after 200 years, salmon return in months

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: An ongoing heat wave serves as a stark reminder of the rising temperatures impacting our oceans. In response, researchers recommend injecting sulfur dioxide into the stratosphere as a cooling strategy that could lessen both the intensity and duration of ocean heat waves. However, this approach does not mitigate ocean acidification, emphasizing the continued need for emissions reduction and carbon sequestration efforts.
title: Earth warming to 6,500-year high; scientists may have a ‘cooling solution’
